'''Clawpack: Hyperbolic Wave Propagation & Conservation Laws'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''Clawpack''' (Conservation Laws Package) is a state-of-the-art software suite designed for solving linear and non-linear hyperbolic systems of partial differential equations using high-resolution Riemann solvers and adaptive mesh refinement (AMR).

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Hyperbolic Conservation Laws (9.0/10):''' Solves continuous field equations expressed in strong conservation form:
<math display="block">\frac{\partial q}{\partial t} + \nabla \cdot f(q) = \psi(q, x, t)</math>
* '''High-Resolution Shock Capturing:''' Accurately tracks non-linear wave steepening, shock formation, and wave-front discontinuities in vacuum energy propagation without numerical instability.
* '''Adaptive Mesh Refinement (ForestClaw / AMRClaw):''' Automatically focuses computational resolution on sharp spatial field gradients or localized particle-like energy solitons.

== Strategic Role in SVD ==
Clawpack provides high-resolution shock and wavefront dynamics analysis for non-linear vacuum field equations derived under SVD postulates.
